name: Story Builder
description: Every student starts a story from the same seed, then the stories travel: each pass, a classmate reads and adds the next sentence. Nobody waits for a turn, every story comes back to its starter finished, and a few get read aloud.
tagline: Perfect for creative writing warm-ups, narrative arcs, and any class that loves a plot twist.

premise.label: The story seed
premise.helper: Every student writes their own opening for this seed, so one seed becomes a whole class of different stories.
premise.default: A mysterious door appears in the school hallway overnight.
premise.deckHelper: Pick a seed with somewhere to go, or write your own (a scene from your novel study works great).

writeTime.label: Time per sentence (seconds)
writeTime.helper: Each of the five writing rounds gets this long. Later rounds include reading the story so far.

storiesRead.label: Stories read aloud at the end
storiesRead.helper: A random sample for the projector. Everyone already gets their own story back, this is the encore.

template.name: Story Builder
template.description: A pass-and-add story chain built with the Story Builder recipe. Every student starts a story; every story comes back finished.

intro.message:
STORY BUILDER

Everyone starts a story from the same seed. Then your story travels: classmates add one sentence at a time and pass it on.

At the end, the story YOU started comes back to you, finished.

start.prompt:
Your seed: ${premise}

Write the OPENING of your story, one or two sentences. Set the scene, introduce someone, and stop before anything gets resolved.

pass-1.prompt: A classmate's story so far is in the box. Read it, then ADD the next sentence. Keep it moving, don't end it!

pass-2.prompt: A new story lands in your hands. Read the whole thing, then ADD the next sentence. Raise the stakes: a twist, a problem, a surprise.

pass-3.prompt: Read this one all the way through, then ADD the next sentence and start steering it toward an ending.

ending.prompt: Last pass! Read the whole story, then write the FINAL sentence. Land the ending.

gallery.message:
STORY TIME

A few finished stories, read aloud. Call out when you hear the sentence you wrote!

end.message: That's Story Builder! Every story had five authors, and every one of you wrote a piece of five different stories.
